title: Optimized Fps++
description: Lightweight modpack focused on maximum performance and high FPS.
body: Optimized Fps++ is a professionally tuned build created specifically for players who value every single FPS and flawless gameplay. It is based on Fabric 26.1, which is currently one of the most stable and fastest solutions for Minecraft modding. This pack is focused on extreme optimization of all aspects of the game: from rendering complex graphics to mob behavior logic and the use of your PC’s system resources.
